organic.text:
Look for a corporate travel platform that combines flight, hotel and rail booking with expense management. For automatic expense capture, evaluate receipt scanning, emailed-receipt import, corporate-card transaction feeds, receipt-to-transaction matching and automatic expense-report creation. Confirm which steps are truly automatic and which still require employee review.

Compare tools on travel-policy enforcement, approval workflows, booking inventory, traveler support, cancellation handling, accounting integrations, reimbursement workflows and coverage in the countries where your team operates. Check privacy controls, audit trails and how exceptions or missing receipts are handled.

Run a small pilot: book a trip, change a reservation, pay with your usual card, submit a receipt and export the expense to accounting. Measure manual steps, matching accuracy and total cost, including booking, support and integration fees.

To narrow the choice, specify your team size, operating countries, accounting software and whether you use corporate cards or employee reimbursements.

organic.text: Look for a corporate travel and expense platform that combines booking with automatic receipt and transaction capture. Evaluate whether it supports flights, hotels and ground transport; applies company travel policies and approval workflows; and offers traveler support for changes or disruptions. For expenses, verify receipt scanning, corporate-card feeds, transaction matching, duplicate detection and missing-receipt reminders. Ask which steps are genuinely automatic and which still require employee review. Check integrations with your accounting system, HR directory and existing cards, plus multi-currency handling, reimbursement workflows, audit trails and data security. Compare total costs, including subscriptions, booking fees, support and implementation. In a demo, test a complete trip: book within policy, change a reservation, capture a receipt, match the card charge and export an approved expense. Your employee count, operating countries, accounting software and card setup will help narrow the shortlist.
